message.content:
I don’t have real‑time market data, so I can’t give you the exact spot price of gold for today.  As of the most recent publicly available data (late‑April 2026), the U.S. spot price of gold was roughly **$1,950–$1,960 per troy ounce**.  Prices fluctuate throughout the trading day, so the current price could be a few dollars higher or lower.

If you need the precise, up‑to‑minute price, you can check a reliable financial news site or a market data platform such as:

- Bloomberg (Gold Spot – US)
- Reuters (Gold Spot – US)
- Kitco (Gold Spot – US)
- CME Group’s Gold Futures page

These sources update the price in real time and will give you the exact figure for the current day.
